title: Microsoft Teams: enhanced media quality for Direct Guest Join
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing explanation and background controls are supported by the sources checked. It correctly distinguishes the meeting directions and reports the newer Google Meet Android release notes alongside the roadmap's older availability statement.

claims.claim: The room mailbox must retain third-party meeting invite bodies so a Join button can be generated.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Prerequisites
claims.claim: Processing third-party and externally scheduled invitations requires the existing external-meeting mailbox configuration.
claims.quote: Configure the Teams Rooms' resource accounts Exchange mailbox to process invites for third-party and externally scheduled meetings.

claims.claim: A Teams Room can join a third-party meeting using its room mailbox username and email address.
claims.quote: If you want to join meetings with the username and email address associated with the room mailbox, select Join with room info.

claims.claim: A custom joining name and email can instead be configured per device.
claims.quote: If you want to join meetings with an alternate username and email address, select Join with custom info and enter username and email address you'd like to use.

claims.claim: The third-party service displays the room's joining identity in its experience.
claims.quote: Specify guest name used to join third party meetings. Third party service will display this data in their experience and may store in their service.

claims.claim: SIP-enabled Teams Rooms use SIP instead of WebRTC for enabled third-party meetings.
claims.quote: Once SIP calling is enabled, the Teams Room automatically uses SIP instead of WebRTC to join the enabled third-party meetings.

claims.claim: Calendar joins automatically fall back to WebRTC DGJ when an invitation lacks a SIP dial string.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms will automatically use Direct Guest Join over WebRTC if the third party meeting invite doesn't contain a SIP dial string. ... Automatic fallback to WebRTC DGJ works for meetings using the calendar join button.

claims.claim: On SIP-enabled rooms, join by ID fails if the meeting lacks SIP capabilities.
claims.quote: If users attempt to use join by ID and the meeting does not have SIP capabilities, the call will fail.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Provider toggles are in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal at Rooms > room > Settings > Meetings > provider.
claims.quote: Select Rooms. ... Select your desired room. ... Select Settings. ... Select Meetings. ... Toggle your desired meeting platforms (for example, Cisco Webex, Zoom, Google Meet, etc.).

claims.claim: The XML element <ZoomMeetingsEnabled>true</ZoomMeetingsEnabled> enables Zoom DGJ, not all three provider toggles.
claims.quote: <ZoomMeetingsEnabled>true</ZoomMeetingsEnabled> ... <ZoomMeetingsEnabled> ... Disabled by default. If true, enables direct guest join experience for Zoom meetings.

claims.claim: The cited Zoom XML setting is applied per Teams Rooms on Windows console using its settings file.
claims.quote: At startup, if a Microsoft Teams Rooms console finds an XML file named SkypeSettings.xml located at C:\Users\Skype\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.SkypeRoomSystem_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalState, it applies the configuration settings indicated by the XML file then deletes the XML file.

claims.where: controls[1].api; controls[1].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Exchange Online PowerShell uses Set-CalendarProcessing <UserPrincipalName> -ProcessExternalMeetingMessages $True -DeleteComments $False per room mailbox.
claims.quote: Connect to Exchange Online PowerShell. ... Replace <UserPrincipalName> with the room mailbox's UPN: Set-CalendarProcessing <UserPrincipalName> -ProcessExternalMeetingMessages $True -DeleteComments $False

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: DeleteComments applies only to resource mailboxes with AutomateProcessing set to AutoAccept.
claims.quote: This parameter is used only on resource mailboxes where the AutomateProcessing parameter is set to AutoAccept.

claims.claim: No admin UI is documented for retaining third-party invite bodies and processing external meeting messages.
claims.quote: Searched: Exchange admin center room mailbox calendar processing ProcessExternalMeetingMessages DeleteComments UI booking options. Opened third-party-join and Manage resource mailboxes in Exchange Online; searched its text for both parameters and message body. No corresponding UI found.

claims.where: controls[2]; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: No tenant-wide UI or automation switch is documented for the DGJ 4×4 grid and simulcast improvements.
claims.quote: Searched: Direct Guest Join 4x4 simulcast default enabled tenant settings PowerShell; Direct Guest Join enhanced media quality tenant switch. Opened third-party-join, pro-portal-settings, xml-config-file and rooms-release-note. No switch for these improvements found.

claims.claim: Pro Management portal settings management applies only to signed-in devices.
claims.quote: Settings management is available only for signed-in devices.

claims.claim: Applying settings in the Pro Management portal queues a settings job.

claims.claim: Applying those settings restarts the device.
claims.quote: restarts the device as soon as possible to apply the setting changes

claims.claim: Schedule Later applies settings during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting business-hour meetings.
claims.quote: Schedule Later - Schedules the settings change to be applied during the nightly maintenance window to avoid disrupting scheduled meetings during business hours.

claims.claim: Learn provides local Windows console steps to enable third-party meeting providers.
claims.quote: To configure Teams Rooms on Windows using the touchscreen console ... Go to the Meetings tab and select a third-party meeting provider you wish to enable

claims.claim: Learn provides local Android device steps to enable third-party meeting providers.
claims.quote: To configure Teams Rooms on Android locally on the device ... Select Meetings. ... Select the toggle next to the third-party meeting providers you want to enable.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends Pro Management portal configuration instead of XML configuration.
claims.quote: We recommend using the individual and bulk settings configuration options within the Teams Rooms Pro Management Portal instead of the XML configuration.

claims.claim: Microsoft states it no longer publishes new XML settings.
claims.quote: We no longer publish new XML settings but all settings are managable within the Portal.

claims.claim: Learn says Defender for Office 365 Safe Links needs no additional steps for the third-party meeting join links.
claims.quote: If your organization uses Microsoft Defender for Office 365 safe links, no additional steps are required.
